capabilities: edit task descriptions inline in rendered Tasks queries via click, Enter to save, Escape to cancel
write edits back to the original task note while preserving status, dates, IDs and other suffix metadata
show muted clickable ancestor context labels below subtasks in flat query results
refuse ambiguous or conflicting edits by checking the source line before writing
disambiguation: Not a general task editor; it only edits descriptions inside rendered Tasks plugin queries and requires that plugin.
extras: Desktop only; mobile is not enabled. Inline writes work only with Tasks 8.4.0 or 8.5.0 and depend on internal Tasks APIs, so other versions show a notice and fall back to the native pencil. Listed in the community directory as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; installable via BRAT (GeoKhv/obsidian-tasks-inline-edit). Runs locally with no network requests.
intentEvidence: This is an independent companion, not an official Obsidian or Tasks product.
problem: The Tasks plugin renders query results as read-only blocks, so fixing a task description means locating its source note and editing it there.

relations.evidence: Task mapping depends on internal Tasks APIs and DOM classes.

summary: Inline editor that lets you edit task descriptions directly inside rendered Tasks queries and writes the text back to the task's source note.
